# TPC-Havoc Q13_v2

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
select
    c_count,
    count(*) as custdist
from (
    select
        c_custkey,
        count(o_orderkey) as c_count
    from
        customer left outer join orders on
            c_custkey = o_custkey
            and o_comment not like '%special%requests%'
    group by
        c_custkey
) as c_orders
group by
    c_count
having
    count(*) > 0
order by
    custdist desc,
    c_count desc
```
